purpose: Protect authored silhouette/traversal/hero features during later feature-aware vista/HLOD generation. This file does not approve distances, triangle budgets, screen-space thresholds or a renderer implementation.

rules: Preserve centerline endpoint relation and skyline turning points.
Preserve R16 load-correlated taper trend and R18 non-circular load-bearing silhouette.

Do not alter gameplay collision source.
Near/mid vista representations must preserve visible support under route corridors.
No HLOD proxy becomes authoritative navigation/collision geometry.
Neighbor representation boundaries require crack-free stitching/skirt policy.
Keep authoritative L3 boundaries compatible with source tile edge coordinates.
